Name: Daylight Pottery
Description: A poor persistent pot has had their precious elixir pinched by pernicious pilferers. Defeat the thieves and restore the stolen property to its rightful, pot-bound owner.

Name: In a Pot of Bother
Description: In their never-ending quest for elixir, several persistent pots have found themselves beset by the isle's wildlife. What brave band of adventurers will cease the crescent fans' cruel sport?

Name: Raging Thrall
Description: Driven to a state of permanent, magically induced frenzy, this hulking familiar threatens to lay waste to the isle. With the North Horn already in a sorry state, putting an end to its wrathful violence is of top priority.

Name: Eye to Eye
Description: With a single cursed gemstone in place of an eye, this dread beast prowls the wastes of the North Horn. Dispense with the creature before you succumb to its baleful gaze.

Name: Shoreline Showdown
Description: This domineering beast stalks the shores of Shadowdeep for fresh prey. Nothing but death will quell its ravenous hunger.

Name: Waved Away
Description: A long, harsh life spent upon the Occult Crescent has toughened this aqueous beast beyond comprehension. Yet even the toughest of hides are no match for a coordinated attack.

Name: Allure of the Occult
Description: In some parts of the North Horn, a near-constant stream of seductive sighs can be heard on the breeze, beckoning wayward souls closer. Few can believe their eyes when they discover the source of these breathy enticements─fewer still survive the ordeal.

Name: Inconstant Gardener
Description: This leaf-clad familiar once labored to maintain the island's delicate ecological balance. Alas, when aetherial anomalies began to plague the North Horn, Iambe was corrupted─much like the land they once nurtured. Ensure they can do no further harm.

Name: Territorial Dispute
Description: Though the North Horn is a barren, inhospitable place, some beasts thrive here, laying claim to swaths of rubble-strewn territory. The ruin hound is one such creature, and it will not take kindly to those who intrude upon its desolate domain.

Name: A Rotten Affair
Description: Undeterred by the fetid pall that chokes the air, this statuesque guardian endures, deadly and vengeful. Though its graceful winged form is a sight to behold, its dominion must be brought to an end.

Name: Gale-force Encounter
Description: Proud of bearing and sharp of claw, this mighty griffin wields the very wind as its weapon. Tread with care, lest a sudden gust sends you flying.

Name: Scale Model
Description: Contrary to its lithe, organic form, this entity is, in fact, a complex, finely wrought golem built in the likeness of an ancient serpentine creature. On an island of replicas, this is one recreation best consigned to oblivion.

Name: Thunderregnum
Description: This regal beast rules over the North Horn, subjugating its kingdom with shocking displays of violence. It is high time the tyrant was toppled from their throne.
